facts.text: Ambergris Cay is a private island in the Turks and Caicos, on the southeast corner of the Turks and Caicos Islands, 600 miles south of Miami.
facts.excerpt: Ambergris Cay, an exclusive private island in the Turks and Caicos, sits 600 miles south of Miami, on the southeast corner of the string of Turks and Caicos Islands

facts.text: Ambergris Cay was first established as a community for private homeowners and opened as a private island resort in 2019.
facts.excerpt: Originally established as a community for private homeowners, Ambergris Cay opened as a private island resort in 2019.

facts.text: Guests have access to over 1,100 acres of mostly untouched land.
facts.excerpt: travelers seeking a secluded luxury escape can enjoy access to over 1,100 acres of mostly untouched land

facts.text: Guests choose between beachfront bungalows along the shore, waterside bungalows with direct calm-water access near the Club House, or privately owned homes and luxury villas.
facts.excerpt: Guests can choose from beachfront bungalows along the shore, waterside bungalows with direct calm-water access and proximity to the Club House, or a collection of privately owned homes and luxury villas

facts.text: Each Waterside Bungalow has a private heated plunge pool, a shaded terrace opening directly onto the water, and a kayak and paddleboard at the shore.
facts.excerpt: each with a private heated plunge pool, a shaded terrace that opens directly onto the water, and a kayak and paddleboard waiting at the shore

facts.text: The Waterside Bungalows have modern Caribbean design with floor-to-ceiling glass.
facts.excerpt: luminous interiors and modern Caribbean design. Floor-to-ceiling glass that erases the line between inside and out

facts.text: Every stay is all-inclusive, covering gourmet dining, premium spirits and cocktails, non-motorized water sports, yoga, electric bikes and tennis with a pro.
facts.excerpt: Every stay at Ambergris Cay is all-inclusive. That means gourmet dining, premium spirits and cocktails, non-motorized water sports, yoga, electric bikes, tennis with a pro

facts.text: Dining settings include poolside bites, deserted beach picnics and all-day dining at Calico restaurant and bar.
facts.excerpt: culinary settings, including poolside bites, deserted beach picnics, and all day dining at Calico restaurant and bar

facts.text: The Hangover Tiki Bar is the island's floating bar, anchored in the turquoise shallows and reached by boat.
facts.excerpt: Hop on a boat to the Hangover Tiki Bar, the island's floating bar anchored in the turquoise shallows

facts.text: Columbus Beach is an Atlantic Coast surf beach.
facts.excerpt: Columbus Beach, Atlantic Coast surf beach

facts.text: Monck Beach is a Caribbean Coast swimming beach.
facts.excerpt: Monck Beach, Caribbean Coast swimming beach

facts.text: The island's narrow, unpaved dirt roads are meant to prevent development that damages fragile ecosystems.
facts.excerpt: Our narrow, unpaved dirt roads allow for effortless exploration, while preventing unnecessary destruction and development known to damage fragile ecosystems

facts.text: Marine activities include kayaking through mangroves, whale watching trips, free diving for conch and bone fishing.
facts.excerpt: from kayaking through mangroves to whale watching trips, free diving for conch, or bone fishing

facts.text: Elevate Spa offers massages and facials.
facts.excerpt: Elevate Spa including massages & facials

facts.text: Massages can be taken in air-conditioned oceanfront cabanas.
facts.excerpt: a post match massage in one of our air-conditioned oceanfront cabanas

facts.text: The Club House is a beach club where beach chairs and umbrellas are always available.
facts.excerpt: Visit the Club House, a sunny beach club where comfortable beach chairs and umbrellas are always available for your use

facts.text: The Club House has an Explorer's Hut for kids from 5 years old, with interactive games and treasure hunts.
facts.excerpt: plus an Explorer’s Hut for kids (from 5 years old) to enjoy interactive games and treasure hunts

facts.text: Ambergris Cay has its own airstrip, purpose-built for seamless arrivals.
facts.excerpt: Ambergris Cay has its own airstrip, purpose-built for seamless arrivals

facts.text: Resort guests get complimentary round-trip air transfers to Ambergris Cay.
facts.excerpt: Guests of the resort enjoy complimentary round-trip air transfers to Ambergris Cay.

facts.text: Guests arriving in South Caicos must arrive by 4:00 p.m. to make the daytime flight connection.
facts.excerpt: we do require guests to arrive by 4:00 p.m. to make the daytime flight connection

facts.text: Spa treatments, motorized water sports including fishing and boat excursions, the reserve wine list, room service and private chef and dining services are not included.
facts.excerpt: Please note the following are not included: spa treatments, motorized water sports, including fishing and other boat excursions, reserve wine list, room service, private chef and dining services.

facts.text: Resort casual is recommended for dinner.
facts.excerpt: though we do recommend resort casual for dinner

facts.text: Dream Estate is the largest villa on Ambergris Cay, with two private chefs and butlers, four heated swimming pools and its own private beach.
facts.excerpt: it is the largest villa on Ambergris Cay and includes two private chef and butlers, four heated swimming pools, and its own private beach

facts.text: Villas come with a 300mm telescope for stargazing and binoculars for whale and bird watching.
facts.excerpt:
300mm telescope for stargazing
- Binoculars for whale and bird watching

facts.text: Each bungalow and villa has an Island Host.
facts.excerpt: Island Host for each bungalow and villa

facts.text: Activities include guided nature walks and bird watching, and sunset at Whale Watchers Point.
facts.excerpt:
Guided nature walks and bird watching
